name: ofp_purp
title: THE PURP synth engine (OP FREAK)
status_note: host-tested and Blackfin-simulator tested; never run on a device
summary: Pick PURP in the synth engine list (or the 'purp' preset): 2 FM-coupled analog-style oscillators with stereo detune, Moog-style ladder, 2 LFOs, mod matrix, per-parameter GEN (DRIFT/STEP/LFO1/LFO2), 8 factory presets. Mono through the engine host, up to 5 voices at 44.1 kHz core rate. TE's envelope, FX, LFO apply.
controls: engine list: PURP; preset browser: folder purp (one preset 'purp')

PURP engine screen (SYNTH key, T1): turn = value, shift+turn = GEN depth, push = cycle GEN mode; shift+blue push next page, shift+green push previous page, shift+white push RESEED, shift+orange push FM snap / MATRIX slot; last page = preset scroller (blue turn)
T1-T4 keep TE's meaning: T2 = TE amp envelope (PURP uses it), T3 = FX, T4 = LFO

sql: INSERT INTO synth_types (id, type, default_params) SELECT MAX(id) + 1, 'purp', '[8192, 8192, 8192, 8192, 4096, 4096, 4096, 4096]' FROM synth_types
